standart.title: Listing standard
standart.lead: Every listing and object card is filled with the same fields so they can be compared. A listing is not published without the required fields; missing recommended fields show a warning.
standart.notCert: This is not a certificate. The standard only defines listing completeness: the platform does not inspect the equipment, figures are as stated by the owner.

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.must: Name, station, type, working hours, at least one service
terminal.should: Tariffs, passport (tracks, crane, warehouse, scale), photos, phone
terminal.note: A passport not confirmed by the owner is compiled from open data and marked as such.
terminal.owner: Organization (type: Terminal): the operator links the profile

siding.title: Siding
siding.must: Registry number, station, region (from the state registry)
siding.should: Length, unloading and loading capacity, owner
siding.note: The owner name appears only after the operator approves the claim. Coordinates are approximate, at node level.
siding.owner: Organization: after the operator approves the claim

rules.heading: Conformance rules
rules.lead: The form checks these rules while you type. A listing that breaks a rule is not saved.
rules.year: Year from 1950 to the current year
rules.rentUnits: Rent price: per month, per day or per hour
rules.truckUnits: Road carrier price: per km, per ton or per trip
rules.priceUnit: A price always comes with a unit
rules.oneObject: Terminal or siding: only one is linked
rules.serviceRegions: Road carriers: the base region is among the service regions
rules.routes: A route starts and ends in different regions
rules.expire: A listing expires after {days} days, the owner republishes it
rules.review: A verified organization's listing goes live at once, others are reviewed

standart.ctaNote: The dashboard form checks against the standard: errors and warnings appear while you type.
